As someone in the optical/medical field, these types of devices do present a health risk in the form of harmful blue light.

Unlike UV which will damage the lens, blue light will penetrate deeper to the retina and cause macular degeneration, basically burning out a portion of the retina. There is currently not a way to reverse these effects, and once it starts we can at best postpone it via an injection to the eye, and this has been happening in people as young as 30.

If you do plan to use one of these regularly, it may be prudent to talk to your doctor about the different coats/lens materials that have recently come out to combat this.
